title: Audit: crypto2dev 2026-04-20
notes:
UAPI stability risk: LOW — All struct layouts are stable with proper padding, reserved fields validated, string null-termination enforced universally, tombstoned slots return -ENOTTY, GET_STATE exposes all diagnostic fields including inbuf_pending/outbuf_pending for all fd types.
Confidence: FIPS gate coverage: 97%, Key material leak risk: 2%, UAPI stability: LOW. Gaps: cannot verify wolfCrypt_GetStatus_fips() return values without a running FIPS module; cannot verify wc_AesCbcEncrypt CBC chaining state reset behavior without executing code; lock ordering correctness on PREEMPT_RT requires kernel lockdep run. Would raise confidence if: (1) lockdep run on PREEMPT_RT kernel with concurrent ioctl stress test, (2) CMVP lab review of the fips_gate ordering relative to state->lock acquisition, (3) valgrind-equivalent kernel memory tool run to verify no leaks under all error paths. Pass 4 found 3 new observability gaps and 0 correctness/FIPS/crypto/kernel/UAPI issues — the core security properties are stable across 4 audit passes.
